title: DoD checklist as PR template
acceptance_criteria: DoD mirrors `backlog/README.md` (criteria demonstrated, ladder green, tests, no secrets/--no-verify, docs+status updated, reviewed for design/security/perf)
goal: Make the Definition of Done a reusable artifact that appears on every PR, not just prose in `backlog/README.md`.
notes: GitHub auto-populates new PRs from this. Reusable for Track B/C repos.
